reason_for_discussion: The proposed full-benchmark acquisition exceeds the initial 1 GiB data-access scope; choosing a smaller new pilot would require a separately fixed research protocol. A verified MG-MAE pretrained checkpoint is still unavailable in audited sources.

recommended_option.name: DATA_FIRST_SINGLE_HDF5_WITH_SEPARATE_DERIVED_TRACK
recommended_option.range_allowlist: Only the 28 pinned pretraining/mmap/<CHANNELS>.npy assets listed in p30_mmap_probe_plan.json; full mmap files remain excluded
recommended_option.small_statistics_and_class_map: Already verified locally; no redundant download required
recommended_option.download_strategy: New dedicated p30 revision directory, direct partial file, exact size and full SHA256 verification, atomic rename only after success, no duplicate snapshot/cache copy
recommended_option.working_space_assumption: One on-disk HDF5 copy; 80 GiB is a proposed reservation, not a measured downloader peak. Extra retained partials or copies are not authorized by this proposal.
recommended_option.research_scope: First lock a scratch/shared-encoder Train/Val protocol with realistic class coverage. Do not call it a lunar-pretrained-representation result or official mmap reproduction before representative full-crop validation.
recommended_option.test_model_scoring: HOLD until the model/configuration/analysis is fixed

alternative_exact_official_mmap_loader.note: The downstream Age/Geology loader recomputes finite/nonzero presence and does not load the packed masks. Full pretraining aligned rasters and repository snapshots are unnecessary.

pretrained_route.mg_mae: Need a verified official checkpoint URL/revision/license/size/hash; do not pretrain from scratch to fill this gap
pretrained_route.nasa_lfm: Input/geometry mapping and separate compatible Python environment must be resolved before requesting its 2425755440-byte backbone and required tokenizers
pretrained_route.pending_research_choice: Proceed with scratch/data baselines first, or prioritize obtaining a verified native pretrained encoder before formal comparisons
